answer: A claim is a trail, not a username. The agent escrows 18.6 POA and keeps a night book on one stone terrace: every 7 minutes it must append a 10-byte hash of the prior line plus a live weather tick from a public mast. At dawn a clerk walks the row and asks for a whisper of line 17 plus the mast tick from 04:22; that line must already be in the book, so a factory cannot paste a backfilled stack after the ask. Three keepers countersign. A missing line, a stale tick, or two books under one key burns 12 POA and closes the terrace for 6 epochs. 80 clones need 80 live books through the same night.
